title: Incorrect behaviour of InputEventMouseButton while holding mouse button
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.3.stable, 4.2.1.stable

### System information

Godot v4.3.stable (77dcf97d8) - Windows 10.0.19045 - GLES3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6094) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-13600KF (20 Threads)

### Issue description

There is big difference between behaviour of two quite similar classes which is responsible for input. In this particular case I'm talking about `InputEventKey `and `InputEventMouseButton`. If you hold the key on keyboard and catch the key being pressed by script, then you will see that the fact that the key is being held is well-detected by engine and its output. Example of the code:

```
func _input(event):
	if event is InputEventKey:
		if event.pressed:
			print("Key on keyboard pressed!")
```

Output:

```
Key on keyboard pressed!
Key on keyboard pressed!
Key on keyboard pressed!
Key on keyboard pressed!
Key on keyboard pressed!
Key on keyboard pressed!
Key on keyboard pressed!
...
```

But if you press and hold the mouse button and try to catch the key being held by script, you will see that there is only one message in output which means that the engine doesn't catch the fact that the mouse button is held which can provide different sufficient problems while coding. Example of the code:

```
func _input(event):	
	if event is InputEventMouseButton:
		if event.pressed:
			print("Key on mouse pressed!")
```

Output:

```
Key on mouse pressed!
```

### Steps to reproduce

Pretty sure that everything is already shown in **Issue description** quite understandable and fully.

[test.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/18278115/test.zip)
